link.note: Named as Henry's widow and William Wells's first wife (Southold records; WikiTree Wells-639; McCurdy). Surname unknown.

summary: John's 11th-great-grandmother; widow of Henry Tuthill who married William Wells.
bio: Sailed with Henry in 1637 ('Henry Tuthill and wife'). After his death she married William Wells about 1650, who became guardian of her Tuthill children; her grandson John Tuthill Jr. later married Wells's daughter Mehitable (by Wells's second wife).
sources: Banks, Planters of the Commonwealth p. 183
